environment.host_note: timed slot was exclusive for this agent; other host workloads may still affect network and CPU. Per-run load averages and foreign sidecar counts are recorded.

exclusions.action: conservatively excluded base matrix repeats 0 and 1 because original rows lacked per-run UTC timestamps; clean rerun supplies those repeats
exclusions.reason: worker accidental live plumbing check (15 YouTube extractions, 13 Bun invocations); worker discarded its numbers

api_smoke.note: Developer-only instrumented smoke, not part of the timed matrix. cProfile and the urlopen wrapper inflate absolute times; use only for rough network-vs-processing shares. One sample is not a distribution.

parser_compatible_json_candidate.note: JSON object output; title, duration, http_headers, format_id, vcodec, acodec, ext, protocol and url are preserved. _type is omitted and defaults to video in the current parser; requested_formats and entries are omitted entirely, not present as null.
parser_compatible_json_candidate.validation: Local-only validation against a saved info JSON with -f bestaudio[protocol=https]; no network request and no live timing. The JVM parser was not run against this candidate.

compact_print_projection.recommendation: Do not switch the production resolver to compact print on this evidence. The tested pipe projection is not parser-compatible. The JSON projection is locally key-safe but not live-timed or JVM-tested, and the measured compact-output gain is only ~10-20 ms; the large gain is skip=hls,dash, already the current production optimization. If adopted later, add a resolver fixture/unit test and one live validation with the audio-only selector; keep dumpjson fallback.

tested_output.note: This is the projection actually timed in the matrix. It is a text projection, not a JSON info dict; the current parser cannot consume it without an adapter.

ffmpeg_location.conclusion: Empty ffmpeg-location preserved format 251/webm/https and all responses in 12/12 paired runs; directionally faster in 9/12 pairs but noisy. Not enough to justify default adoption without a resolver-level paired confirmation. Safe only for URL-only extraction with no merge/postprocess; it hides ffmpeg/ffprobe availability and must not replace a toolchain capability check.
ffmpeg_location.note: empty private directory; no ffmpeg/ffprobe binaries; URL-only print, no download or postprocessing

paired_analysis.note: negative paired values show network noise; aggregate p50 was ~5 ms apart while paired median favored empty location by ~131 ms. Treat as promising, not decision-grade.

visitor_data.conclusion: Explicit anonymous visitorData did not make webpage-skipping reliable: 2/3 public videos still failed LOGIN_REQUIRED. The one success still paid ~0.94 s setup + 1.72 s extraction, slower than the warm webpage-kept path. Do not skip webpage; do not treat visitorData as a substitute for cookies.
visitor_data.method: Anonymous watch-page GET in memory, regex-extracted exact visitorData, passed via a mode-0600 temporary --config-locations file, deleted after each run; value never placed in argv or saved in this artifact.

broken_solver.note: shim answers --version then exits 3 for the solver call

probe_403_control.note: local synthetic 403; no external request and no media URL in report

visionos_without_webpage.note: upstream-supported shortcut, but not safe as a default: webpage/visitor data is load-bearing for some public videos

default_tmp.note: PyInstaller one-file bootstrap extracts into TMPDIR on each run

shm_tmp.note: PyInstaller one-file bootstrap extracts into TMPDIR on each run

worktree_tmp.note: PyInstaller one-file bootstrap extracts into TMPDIR on each run

host_contention.handling: excluded original matrix repeats 0 and 1 wholesale; replaced with clean 2-repeat rerun (batch rerun-clean); no failed rows removed
host_contention.note: Other parent/worker activity was held for the clean rerun and supplemental experiments. Absolute network latency is not assumed identical to another host or time window.
host_contention.source: worker disclosure; 15 live YouTube extractions and 13 Bun invocations, serialized; worker discarded its numbers

limitations: No cookies, account context, age-restricted, members-only or premium video.
No JVM/application scheduling, libVLC playback, or parent whole-app budget.
YouTube responses, bot checks, player JS and CDN latency vary by request.
Visionos has no cookie support upstream; it cannot stand in for authenticated extraction.
The cache experiment only exercises upstream-supported n/sig solver reuse; no player cache is enabled.
A 5-10 sample block gives wide p95 uncertainty; p95 is near max for small n.
Probe success proves a ranged head/tail response, not audible playback.
The visitorData result is three one-shot samples; it establishes a failure mode, not a success rate.
The ffmpeg-location result is 12 pairs on one host; the paired direction is promising but noisy, and the aggregate p50 differs by only ~5 ms.
Retained base matrix rows from repeats 2-5 lack per-run UTC timestamps; only whole-repeat exclusion plus the clean rerun is claimed.
No new-video/object-cache reuse experiment was run beyond the same-video cache variant; the API object reuse is a single smoke sample, not a distribution.
The host was shared earlier in the run; absolute network latency is not assumed identical to another host or time window.

matrix.quantile_note: Hyndman-Fan type 7 linear interpolation over successful runs; n is the successful-run count, while attempted/failed counts are reported separately so the success denominator includes failures
matrix.source: clean rerun block plus uncontaminated base repeats

cold_warm.cache-private: standard upstream cache in a private directory
cold_warm.cold-binary: new process after best-effort posix_fadvise DONTNEED on yt-dlp and bun; DNS/TLS/CDN state is not evicted
cold_warm.object-warm: only the --mode api instrumentation reuses one YoutubeDL object
cold_warm.warm: new process, warm OS page cache, default /tmp tmpfs

methodology.contamination: Worker live-plumbing overlap 2026-10-21T11:11:05.750Z..11:11:39.236Z; original repeats 0-1 excluded wholesale and replaced by a clean 2-repeat rerun. Base repeats 2-5 had no per-run UTC timestamps and are not used to prove exact non-overlap.
methodology.experiments: Supplemental visitorData (3 one-shot videos), empty --ffmpeg-location (12 interleaved pairs), API cProfile smoke (1 sample), cold-binary block, venv comparison, and negative controls are stored separately from the main matrix.
methodology.interleaving: configs are shuffled within each video/repeat block and videos are shuffled per repeat; a fixed seed is recorded

measured_vs_inferred.inferred: PyInstaller/frozen bootstrap portion of boot, network vs parse inside a request window, and any whole-app extrapolation
measured_vs_inferred.instrumentation_overhead: verbose logging, line timestamping, 5 ms /proc sampling, and cProfile are included; see measured overhead fields and limitations
measured_vs_inferred.measured: wall clock, process-tree sampled CPU/RSS, marker intervals, HTTP statuses/bytes, Bun lifetime observations

methodology.preferred_quantiles: p50/p90/p95/max over successful runs; attempted, succeeded, failed and success_rate are always reported
methodology.quantiles: Hyndman-Fan type 7 linear interpolation over successful runs; n is the successful-run count, while attempted/failed counts are reported separately so the success denominator includes failures
methodology.stage_source: pinned yt-dlp verbose markers timestamped at the harness pipe; request windows are inclusive of following parse work
methodology.timestamps: Rerun rows carry started_utc/ended_utc. First-revision base rows do not; no timestamps were fabricated.
